research_question: Can one truth-blind bound-aware feasibility-restoring line-search Gauss-Newton mechanism improve common-assessor local recovery without a safety, stratum, or callback-work regression?

candidate.name: RESTORING-GN-CPQR
candidate.coordinates: direct midpoint/half-range normalization to the closed [-1,1]^n box
candidate.initial_feasibility: if the start is invalid, require a valid normalized box center and bisect the center-to-start segment until its bracket is no wider than the finite-difference step
candidate.jacobian: preferred forward one-sided difference; use the symmetric opposite-sign point after an invalid or unavailable side and halve the radius up to 16 times
candidate.linear_step: column-pivoted QR with leading numerical rank threshold max(m,n)*eps*max(abs(diag(R))); truncate rather than add fixed damping
candidate.bound_step: clip the proposed normalized point and form all model tests with the resulting effective step
candidate.globalization: backtracking factor 0.5; Armijo coefficient 1e-4; actual/predicted reduction floor 1e-4; at most 24 trials
candidate.invalid_trial: charge callback, reject, and continue the same radius/line-search backoff; never synthesize a penalty residual
candidate.authority: candidate convergence and acceptance flags are diagnostic; the common assessor owns qualification and safety

corpus.description: the unchanged five-case local T0 plus the existing on-boundary strict-guard counterexample

execution.prefix_policy: one paired-start stream per case/variant; snapshot only after the first completed attempt crossing each threshold; do not rerun prefixes
execution.prefix_overshoot_role: recorded diagnostic only; cumulative threshold-crossing work is not the promotion work metric
execution.primary_work: for each case, earliest suffix-stable common-assessor safe-full callback work from raw attempts; miss or value above 4800 is right-censored to 4800; aggregate by summing cases
execution.case_parallelism: one case per process; at most 6 processes for this T0
execution.precondition: commit these sources and run from a clean worktree only after root approval

promotion_gate.primary_work: sum of per-case suffix-stable common-assessor safe-full callback work, right-censored at 4800
promotion_gate.path_a: target and safe-full noninferior, at least one strictly higher, and right-censored common-assessor work ratio <= 1.20
promotion_gate.path_b: target and safe-full noninferior and right-censored common-assessor work ratio <= 0.80
promotion_gate.strict_guard_counterexample: candidate common-assessor safe-full is true and at least one assessor-qualified endpoint follows a diagnostic-recorded restored start, FD sign reversal, invalid FD trial, or invalid line-search trial
promotion_gate.passing_scope: authorizes only a separately preregistered T1; not production integration

pre_outcome_counterexamples: invalid initial point with valid box-center segment anchor
invalid midpoint causing typed initial-infeasible termination
throwing domain side causing charged FD sign reversal
invalid full Gauss-Newton trial restored by backtracking
rank-one system handled by truncated CPQR
rank-zero model causing typed rank-stalled termination
candidate callback cap reached without overdraw
